title: 1st Quarter Earnings Call 2026
summary: The pre-recorded conference call and audio webcast features prepared remarks from Ellen Cotter, President & Chief Executive Officer; Gilbert Avanes, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer; and Andrzej Matyczynski, Executive Vice President – Global Operations. body_markdown:
The pre-recorded conference call and audio webcast features prepared remarks from Ellen Cotter, President & Chief Executive Officer; Gilbert Avanes, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer; and Andrzej Matyczynski, Executive Vice President – Global Operations.


Question and answer session will follow the formal remarks.
